summary.text: Brandon Young is the Democratic candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces John Taylor (R).
A filmmaker, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include the economy, public education and the environment.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Young graduated from Fremont High School and attended Broadview Entertainment Arts University, and his career experience includes working as a filmmaker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Utahn, husband, father, filmmaker and community advocate.

His three key messages were the economy, including fair wages, workers' rights and affordable health care; public education, including investment in public schools, smaller classes and limits on school vouchers; and the environment, including the Great Salt Lake, clean air and water, and transparency about developments such as data centers and nuclear power.
